# Agora Web Beauty Effect Extension

`agora-extension-beauty-effect` adds real-time beauty effects to video tracks created with the Agora RTC Web SDK. It provides skin lightening, smoothing, sharpening, redness adjustment, and contrast control through the SDK media processor pipeline.

## Requirements

- Agora RTC Web SDK 4.12.0 or later is recommended.
- Serve the application over HTTPS or from `localhost` so the browser can access the camera.

## Install

Install the Web SDK and the beauty effect extension from npm:

```bash
npm install agora-rtc-sdk-ng agora-extension-beauty-effect
```

Import both packages in your application:

```ts
import AgoraRTC from "agora-rtc-sdk-ng";
import BeautyExtension from "agora-extension-beauty-effect";
```

## Quick Start

Create and register one extension instance, create a processor, and pipe a local camera track through it before publishing the track.

```ts
import AgoraRTC from "agora-rtc-sdk-ng";
import BeautyExtension from "agora-extension-beauty-effect";

const APP_ID = "<YOUR_APP_ID>";
const CHANNEL_NAME = "<YOUR_CHANNEL_NAME>";
const TOKEN: string | null = "<YOUR_TOKEN>";

const client = AgoraRTC.createClient({ mode: "rtc", codec: "vp8" });

const extension = new BeautyExtension();
AgoraRTC.registerExtensions([extension]);

const processor = extension.createProcessor();

processor.setOptions({
  lighteningContrastLevel: 1,
  lighteningLevel: 0.6,
  smoothnessLevel: 0.5,
  sharpnessLevel: 0.3,
  rednessLevel: 0.1,
});

processor.onoverload = () => {
  console.warn("Beauty processing is taking too long for the current device");
};

const localVideoTrack = await AgoraRTC.createCameraVideoTrack({
  encoderConfig: "720p_2",
});

localVideoTrack
  .pipe(processor)
  .pipe(localVideoTrack.processorDestination);

await processor.enable();
localVideoTrack.play("local-player");

await client.join(APP_ID, CHANNEL_NAME, TOKEN);
await client.publish([localVideoTrack]);
```

`APP_ID`, `CHANNEL_NAME`, and `TOKEN` in the example are application-specific values. See the [Agora RTC Web documentation](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/javascript/advanced-features/extensions/image-enhancement) for the complete integration flow.

## Configure Beauty Effects

Call `processor.setOptions()` before or after enabling the processor. Calling it again updates the active effect without recreating the processor.

```ts
processor.setOptions({
  lighteningContrastLevel: 2,
  lighteningLevel: 0.7,
  smoothnessLevel: 0.65,
  sharpnessLevel: 0.25,
  rednessLevel: 0.15,
});
```

| Option | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lighteningContrastLevel` | `0 \| 1 \| 2` | `0`, `1`, or `2` | `1` | Lightening contrast: low, normal, or high. Use it together with `lighteningLevel`. |
| `lighteningLevel` | `number` | `0.0` to `1.0` | `0.6` | Skin lightening strength. `0.0` preserves the original brightness. |
| `smoothnessLevel` | `number` | `0.0` to `1.0` | `0.5` | Skin smoothing strength. |
| `sharpnessLevel` | `number` | `0.0` to `1.0` | `0.3` | Image sharpening strength. |
| `rednessLevel` | `number` | `0.0` to `1.0` | `0.1` | Skin redness adjustment. |

The extension throws an error when a supplied option is outside its valid range.

## Enable, Disable, and Remove

Disable the effect temporarily without removing the processor from the track:

```ts
await processor.disable();
```

While disabled, the original input track is passed through. Re-enable the existing processor to avoid reinitializing its resources:

```ts
await processor.enable();
```

When the processor is no longer needed, disable it and remove it from the track pipeline:

```ts
await processor.disable();
localVideoTrack.unpipe();

localVideoTrack.stop();
localVideoTrack.close();
```

Reuse a processor when toggling beauty effects. Creating multiple processors for the same workflow increases CPU and GPU usage.

## Script Tag Usage

The package also contains a UMD bundle named `agora-extension-beauty.js`. Load the Agora Web SDK first, then load the extension bundle:

```html
<script src="./AgoraRTC_N-production.js"></script>
<script src="./agora-extension-beauty.js"></script>

<script>
  const client = AgoraRTC.createClient({ mode: "rtc", codec: "vp8" });
  const extension = new BeautyExtension();

  AgoraRTC.registerExtensions([extension]);

  const processor = extension.createProcessor();
  processor.setOptions({
    lighteningContrastLevel: 1,
    lighteningLevel: 0.6,
    smoothnessLevel: 0.5,
    sharpnessLevel: 0.3,
    rednessLevel: 0.1,
  });
</script>
```

## Performance Guidance

- Test performance with the same resolution, frame rate, device class, and additional extensions used in production.
- Set `processor.onoverload` to observe sustained processing pressure and reduce capture resolution or frame rate when needed.
- Reuse the same processor when enabling and disabling the effect.
- Running several video processors or other graphics-heavy applications at the same time can cause dropped frames.
- On laptops, avoid battery-saving modes when consistent video quality is required.
